# simplevm_image (Data Source)

Looks up a VM image by name, including its research environment template (if any).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplevm_image" "ubuntu" {
  name = "Ubuntu 22.04"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact image name, for example `Ubuntu 22.04`.

### Optional

- `include_snapshots` (Boolean) Also search snapshot images. Regular images win on a name clash. Defaults to `false`.
- `project_id` (Number) SimpleVM project ID. Defaults to the provider `project_id`; the effective value is exported.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, the OpenStack ID of the image.
- `is_snapshot` (Boolean) Whether the image is a snapshot image.
- `min_disk` (Number) Minimum disk size in GB.
- `min_ram` (Number) Minimum RAM in MB.
- `openstack_id` (String) OpenStack ID of the image.
- `os_distro` (String) Operating system distribution.
- `os_version` (String) Operating system version.
- `resenv_template_name` (String) Research environment template of the image, empty if none.
- `tags` (List of String) Image tags.
- `title` (String) Human-readable image title.
